test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'REPLACE' is coded as '67' and 'PETRIFY' is coded as '106'. How will 'CRACKED' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Number of letters within the words are added to the sum of the position values according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• 'REPLACE' is coded as '67'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d8def846c27d9c78ae9085fa242abcbb3b1d685b018a2f7de8d4a3021ada143.png] 

And,

 
• 'PETRIFY' is coded as '106'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c267926ca2841a554877dec718fdd5fcc78565472bd9e0a6cf99087abb54aa6.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'CRACKED' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d75af3ef4eb42f4338f2b695e9ca1a9a9cc02c81728984333f933e76807a740d.png] 

​Hence, "52" is the correct answer.
